method: prepare_dsview_observer.py followed by analyze_clock.py over the retained Capture A CSV, UART log, and observer epoch record; no hardware was connected
reason: Only Capture A supplies a matched H3 GPIO Epoch and UART sequence. Capture B is an IRQ pulse-width witness with no CH0 Epoch. The Phase 1 protocol requires three independent real sessions before a frozen allowable alignment bound may be accepted.
interpretation_limit: The numeric field is a reproducible one-session calibration observation, not an accepted multi-session alignment bound and not a Phase 2 or fault-truth input.
